svg.title: nayots.com — personal site
svg.desc: nayots.com: a name rendered as luminous stardust, about a hundred thousand GPU-simulated particles forming the wordmark, built with WebGL and three.js and served statically on Vercel. Shows the nayots keystone-star monogram in particles. Links to nayots.com.

g.text: My corner of the web: a name rendered as
luminous stardust — about a hundred thousand
